en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a lively European city street or square lined with multi‑story buildings and trees. A fountain or circular flowerbed is in the foreground, and a baroque church tower rises prominently in the background along the main street. Well‑dressed people in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll and gather in the square. Large printed German text and handwritten notes appear at the bottom, including the red word "Graz."
